COMMON_SEGMENTS.description: Profiles that became a paying customer in the last 30 days.
COMMON_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: customer_since >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '30 days')

COMMON_SEGMENTS.description: Profiles with predictive customer lifetime value of 10,000,000 VND or more.
Profiles the churn model places in the high or critical tier (model-based; not the 'churn_risk' lifecycle stage).
Profiles with no activity in the last 90 days.
Profiles active in the last 30 days.
Mid-value profiles (predictive CLV from 5,000,000 VND to under 10,000,000 VND) with room to grow into high-value customers.
Existing customers inactive for 30-180 days with medium or higher churn risk.
COMMON_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip', 'dormant', 'churn_risk') AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '180 days') AND churn_risk_tier IN ('medium', 'high', 'critical')

COMMON_SEGMENTS.description: Long-tenure (over 1 year) customers with predictive CLV above 25,000,000 VND who are still active in the last 90 days; prioritize for loyalty experiences.
COMMON_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: predictive_clv > 25000000 AND customer_since < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '365 days') AND last_activity_at >= (now() - INTERVAL '90 days')

COMMON_SEGMENTS.description: Profiles with an engagement score of 75 or higher.
Profiles with an engagement score below 30 that may need re-engagement.
Profiles with an NPS score of 9-10 (strong advocacy signal).
Profiles with an NPS score of 0-6 that may need service recovery.
Prospects and leads with a conversion probability of 0.7 or higher.
Operational segment (not for marketing activation): profiles with identity confidence below 0.6.
Operational segment (not for marketing activation): profiles with completeness below 70%.
Profiles aged 18-29 (Gen Z and young millennials), from date_of_birth.
COMMON_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: (date_of_birth <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '18 years') AND date_of_birth > ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '30 years'))
(date_of_birth <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '30 years') AND date_of_birth > ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '45 years'))
(date_of_birth <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '45 years') AND date_of_birth > ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '60 years'))

COMMON_SEGMENTS.description: Profiles aged 60 or older, from date_of_birth.
COMMON_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: date_of_birth <= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '60 years')

RETAIL_SEGMENTS.description: Retail customers whose preferred channel is a physical store or POS.
RETAIL_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND preferred_channel IN ('In-Store', 'POS', 'Store')

RETAIL_SEGMENTS.description: Retail profiles first acquired through coupon, affiliate or deal-site channels.
Retail profiles first acquired through Shopee, Lazada or TikTok Shop marketplaces.
Retail profiles with predictive CLV of 15,000,000 VND or more (CLV is a proxy; true basket value lives in domain attributes).
Retail customers at high or critical churn risk who went quiet 14-90 days ago (still recoverable).
RETAIL_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND churn_risk_tier IN ('high', 'critical') AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '14 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '90 days')

RETAIL_SEGMENTS.description: Engaged retail profiles stitched from 3 or more raw profiles (identity-touchpoint proxy for multi-channel behavior).

ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.description: Online-first customers (website, app or Zalo) who converted in the last 30 days.
ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND preferred_channel IN ('Website', 'Mobile App', 'Zalo') AND customer_since >= ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '30 days')

ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.description: Online-first customers with predictive CLV above 20,000,000 VND.
ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND preferred_channel IN ('Website', 'Mobile App', 'Zalo') AND predictive_clv > 20000000

ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.description: Online prospects and leads with a conversion probability of 0.45 or higher.
ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND preferred_channel IN ('Website', 'Mobile App', 'Zalo') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.45 AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead')

ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.description: Online customers at medium churn risk: the early-warning tier below 'At Risk of Churn'.
ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND preferred_channel IN ('Website', 'Mobile App', 'Zalo') AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND churn_risk_tier = 'medium'

ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.description: Existing online customers with no activity for at least 90 days.
ECOMMERCE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'retail' AND preferred_channel IN ('Website', 'Mobile App', 'Zalo') AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip', 'dormant', 'churn_risk') AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '90 days')

TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.description: Highly engaged travel profiles stitched from 3 or more raw profiles (proxy for trip frequency).
Travel profiles with predictive CLV of 25,000,000 VND or more.
High-intent travel leads (probability 0.5+) quiet for 14-90 days; still worth a recovery nudge.
TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'travel' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.5 AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '14 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '90 days')

TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.description: Established travel customers (over 1 year) with predictive CLV from 8,000,000 VND to under 25,000,000 VND.
TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'travel' AND customer_since < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '365 days') AND predictive_clv >= 8000000 AND predictive_clv < 25000000

TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.description: Travel customers at high or critical churn risk.
TRAVEL_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'travel' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND churn_risk_tier IN ('high', 'critical')

EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.description: Education prospects and leads with enrollment probability of 0.65 or higher.
EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'education' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.65

EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.description: Learners with engagement of 70+ who were active in the last 14 days.
EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'education' AND engagement_score >= 70 AND last_activity_at >= (now() - INTERVAL '14 days')

EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.description: Current learners with low engagement (below 40) and medium or higher churn risk.
EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'education' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND engagement_score < 40 AND churn_risk_tier IN ('medium', 'high', 'critical')

EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.description: Education customers of over 1 year with an NPS score of 9-10 (referral and testimonial candidates).
EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'education' AND customer_since < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '365 days') AND latest_nps_score >= 9

EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.description: Previously enrolled learners inactive for 120-365 days with a return probability of 0.4 or higher.
EDUCATION_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'education' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'dormant', 'churn_risk') AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '120 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '365 days') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.4

REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.description: Real estate leads graded A or Hot, prioritized for fast follow-up.
REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'real_estate' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND lead_grade IN ('A', 'Hot')

REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.description: Real estate profiles with predictive CLV above 100,000,000 VND (high-value proxy; investor intent lives in domain attributes).
Real estate leads (probability 0.35+) quiet for 30-180 days; keep nurturing through a long consideration journey.
REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'real_estate' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.35 AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '30 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '180 days')

REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.description: Real estate leads with engagement 65+ and conversion probability 0.55+, ready for a property tour.
REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'real_estate' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND engagement_score >= 65 AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.55

REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.description: Real estate profiles with medium or higher churn risk and negative sentiment.
REAL_ESTATE_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'real_estate' AND churn_risk_tier IN ('medium', 'high', 'critical') AND overall_sentiment_score < 0

BANKING_SEGMENTS.description: Banking customers whose preferred channel is the mobile or internet banking app, with engagement of 60+.
BANKING_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'banking' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND preferred_channel IN ('Mobile App', 'Internet Banking App') AND engagement_score >= 60

BANKING_SEGMENTS.description: Banking customers with predictive CLV of 50,000,000 VND or more.
BANKING_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'banking' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND predictive_clv >= 50000000

BANKING_SEGMENTS.description: Existing banking customers with a new-product propensity of 0.6+ and low-to-medium churn risk.
BANKING_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'banking' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.6 AND churn_risk_tier IN ('low', 'medium')

BANKING_SEGMENTS.description: Banking customers at high or critical churn risk; route to retention outreach.
BANKING_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'banking' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND churn_risk_tier IN ('high', 'critical')

MEDIA_SEGMENTS.description: Highly engaged media profiles (80+) active in the last 7 days.
MEDIA_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'media' AND engagement_score >= 80 AND last_activity_at >= (now() - INTERVAL '7 days')

MEDIA_SEGMENTS.description: Media prospects and leads with engagement of 50+ and conversion probability of 0.5+.
MEDIA_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'media' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('prospect', 'lead') AND engagement_score >= 50 AND lead_conversion_probability >= 0.5

MEDIA_SEGMENTS.description: Media customers inactive for 14-60 days with medium or higher churn risk.
MEDIA_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'media' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND last_activity_at < (now() - INTERVAL '14 days') AND last_activity_at > (now() - INTERVAL '60 days') AND churn_risk_tier IN ('medium', 'high', 'critical')

MEDIA_SEGMENTS.description: Media customers of over 1 year with engagement 60+ and low churn risk.
MEDIA_SEGMENTS.sql_rules: domain = 'media' AND lifecycle_stage IN ('customer', 'vip') AND customer_since < ((now() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh')::date - INTERVAL '365 days') AND engagement_score >= 60 AND churn_risk_tier = 'low'
